senior_addl_exemption_single.unit: $ per filer age 65+ or legally blind

senior_addl_exemption_mfj.unit: $ per qualifying spouse age 65+ or legally blind

social_security.note: Fully subtracted from AGI, no income limit.

retirement_income.note: Pensions (government and most private), 401(k)/403(b)/457, traditional & Roth IRA distributions, and railroad retirement are all subtracted from AGI -- no age requirement, no dollar cap.

senior_tax_credits.note: The $1,000 additional personal exemption for age 65+ is IL's income-tax-specific senior break; since retirement income is already fully exempt, this mainly benefits seniors with wage/investment income.

effective_rate_pct.unit: % of home value/year, statewide avg effective rate
effective_rate_pct.note: One of the two highest in the nation; Tax Foundation's CY2023-data figure is 2.07%.

property_tax.relief_programs_note: Senior Citizens Assessment Freeze Homestead Exemption ('Senior Freeze'): age 65+, freezes the assessed value used to compute property tax; household income limit $65,000 for 2025 assessment year (payable 2026), rising to $75,000 for 2026 assessment year (payable 2027) under PA 104-0452, then $77,000 (2027) and $79,000 (2028+) -- up to $10,000/household of retirement-plan RMDs excluded from the income test. A separate, non-income-tested Senior Citizens Homestead Exemption gives a flat EAV reduction, but the amount is set locally by county and not modeled here. Both are excluded from the estimate below.
